flaws.description: Changed the x-axis label on all three box-plot panels from 'Year' to 'Quarter', mislabeling the time-unit dimension actually shown (years 1975, 1980, 1985).

Swapped the data arguments passed to the first two boxplot() calls so the IMF Credit subplot now renders the Defense Expenditure values and vice versa, while titles, axis labels, colors, and draw order remain unchanged.
